title: Term-Timing Adjustment on Rental Upgrade Difference Charges
content:
**Rule.** The term-timing adjustment on a Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge is a loading of 0.03 when the upgrade was made more than 150 days after the term start date, a credit of 0.05 when it was made no more than 60 days after the term start date, and 0 otherwise.

| Days from the term start date to the upgrade date | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 60 or fewer | credit 0.05 |
| 61 to 150 | 0 |
| more than 150 | loading 0.03 |

The term start date is the one on the contract; the upgrade date is the plan change date on the contract.

**How the adjustment acts.** Concessions and credits on an upgrade difference charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* a term starting 15 January and an upgrade on 3 May, 108 days in: no adjustment. An upgrade on 1 March, 45 days in: credit 0.05.
